headline: Supporting Artisan Communities and Traditional Handlooms
subheadline: Sustaining India's rich handloom heritage through direct market access and ethical trade linkages.
description: Through our cluster initiatives, Shree Durga Agency collaborates directly with artisan weaving collectives, block-print clusters, and hand-embroidery units, ensuring fair compensation, preserved traditions, and direct market visibility.

pillars.title: Varanasi & Chanderi Weaver Linkages
pillars.summary: Connecting generational master weavers with urban retail showrooms, ensuring fair craft pricing without exploitation by layered middlemen.
programs: Direct trade facilitation with hereditary weaver families in Varanasi and Mubarakpur
Raw silk and zari procurement assistance to buffer seasonal price volatility
Promotion of authentic GI-tagged handloom weaves among premium retail buyers

pillars.title: Jaipur & Bagru Block Print Preservation
pillars.summary: Promoting sustainable natural dyes, water-conscious washing practices, and preservation of wooden block carving traditions.
programs: Workshops on natural vegetable dye stabilization and eco-friendly mordants
Direct buyer linkages for traditional Sanganeri and Bagru mud-resist print artisans
Fair advance payment terms to support artisan families during lean monsoon seasons

pillars.title: Women Artisans & Zari Embroidery Units
pillars.summary: Supporting women hand-embroidery artisans in fine Zardozi, Aari, and Kantha stitchwork through steady seasonal contract assignments.
programs: Structured piece-rate pricing guaranteeing transparent and timely wage payouts
Basic financial literacy and digital banking guidance for women artisans
Quality standardization workshops to reduce sample rejection rates
